name: Golem, Bladed
body:
Bladed Golem CR 9

XP 6,400
N Large construct
Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 8, flat-footed 28 (–1 Dex, +20 natural, –1 size)
hp 96 (12d10+30)
Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +4
DR 10/bludgeoning; Immune construct traits, magic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +23 (2d8+9)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 28; Dex 9, Con —, Int —; Wis 11; Cha 1
Base Atk +14; CMB +24; CMD 33

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

A bladed golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below.

A shatter spell causes a bladed golem 4d10 HP of damage.

A transmute metal to wood spell causes a bladed golem 6d10 damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or gang (2–4)
Treasure none

A bladed golem has an armed and armored body made from metal, within which is a watchwork assembly of mechanical parts. Like most golems, a bladed golem cannot speak and makes whirring and clicking sounds when it moves. A bladed golem is 7 feet tall and weighs around 1,400 pounds.

A bladed golem’s body is reinforced with mithral, and houses a carefully constructed assembly of machinery. The bladed golem’s heart is made from a large sapphire. The sapphire must have a value of at least 2,000 gp.

Crafting this Golem

CL 12th; Price 57,000 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Construct, Spells animate object, geas/quest, blade barrier, badger’s ferocity, Special creator must be caster level 12th; Skill Checks Craft (mechanical devices) or Craft (blacksmithing) DC 18; Cost 30,000 gp
